prompt.text:
Implement an in-memory publication catalog. Export `Publication`, `LookupResult`, and `PublicationCatalog`. A publication has readonly `id`, `title`, `summary`, and `publishedOn` strings. The constructor accepts a readonly publication array. IDs must be positive safe integers and unique; title and summary must contain at least one non-whitespace character; `publishedOn` must exactly match `YYYY-MM-DD`. Invalid input throws `TypeError`, while duplicate IDs throw `RangeError`. `find(id)` returns `{ ok: true, publication }` or `{ ok: false, message: "Publication not found" }`; malformed lookup IDs return the same failure rather than throwing. `list()` returns all publications in constructor order. The catalog must defensively copy constructor input and return fresh publication objects and arrays, so caller mutation cannot affect stored data. An empty catalog is valid and lists as an empty array.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
